precompile_semantics: Isolated temp project + temp first depot (read-through to the user depot); the preference is written to the temp project's LocalPreferences.toml BEFORE Pkg.instantiate, so the install-time precompile already runs under it. The copied sources are identified by uuid + git-tree-sha1 (the Base.version_slug depot dir) — exact pinned identity, not a version-string match — and must land at the exact slug path in the temp depot so Pkg resolves them there. Vulkan.jl 0.6.30 @compile_workload gates the device workload on preference PRECOMPILE_DEVICE_FUNCTIONS (default auto). auto: workload runs, its no-driver failure is caught+logged (loader 'Found no drivers' visible), precompile succeeds; false: workload skipped; true: failure rethrown, Pkg.precompile(Vulkan) fails with INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER.
